data.name: Build In Space
data.detailed_description:
Build In Space is a tycoon game focused on creativity and having fun while bringing your ideas to life!

Start with a small patch of soil and build a massive farming empire among the stars! Plant and harvest a wide variety of crops, earn credits, unlock powerful upgrades, and expand your space station into a thriving production hub. Show off your creations to other players, collect rare rewards, discover special events, and compete to build the most successful colony in the galaxy. With constant progression, exciting unlocks, and endless ways to grow, your journey from rookie farmer to space tycoon awaits.

Characteristics:

  • Grow crops!

    Start slow by planting seeds and watch them grow into beautiful crops you can harvest. You can sell the goods you get from them to earn credits and buy even better seeds or helpful upgrades.

  • Build!

    Bring your ideas to life using the items you buy to make the things you want to in your personal bay. Edit them, change their colors and combine them to create something uniquely yours.

  • Unlock upgrades! 

    With the credits you get, unlock powerful upgrades that will help you bring your creations to life.

  • Show your creations to others! 

    Join a lobby of up to 8 simultaneous players and show them what you have made. Share with others your ideas and inspire them to make their own creations in the game. 

  • Play in VR or PC

    You can play Build In Space in either VR or PC, letting you enjoy the game the way you want to.

  • Special rewards and events

    There are constant updates with exciting events and new things for the game. You can also compete against other players to see who makes the best farming empire, unlocking rare rewards such as special seeds and more.

  • Have fun!

    The game is meant to be a canvas for your imagination, so don't be afraid to let it go wild and enjoy the time you spend playing.

data.short_description: Build In Space is a relaxing tycoon game where you can grow crops, build your base, and raise animals.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Window 11
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • VR Support: OpenXR — Meta Quest 2 and Meta Quest 3 via Meta Quest Link, requires motion controllers
  • Additional Notes: VR supported via OpenXR (SteamVR, Meta Quest Link, and compatible headsets). Game automatically switches between Desktop and VR based on headset detection.
